g.text: Signed RPE (red) · uRPE (green) · surprise (blue) · numbers mark the ROIs of a
Which tail each patch belongs to is resolved in the companion figure, and exactly in a. No voxel is ever in both tails of
the same signal, so a hue never means two things at once within one patch.
